value.rationale: The crown graph is the canonical perfect-matching deletion of K_{n,n}. The theorem shows that this perturbation leaves the scalar 2-rainbow domination number at 4 while forcing a sharp index-aligned structure on every optimum. For n>=5 the exact multiplicity 2n^2-n and the equivalent classification of minimum dominating sets in the prism provide structural information not captured by the scalar invariant or by the complete-multipartite theorem.
